title: A meaningful increase.

lines.text: The intern’s post has received ninety-three impressions.
She spent most of yesterday getting the example right.
What happened after the impression?
The platform describes it as discovery.
Did anyone ask us anything?
Yes. Someone wants the onboarding checklist in the post.
I have included community engagement in the summary.
We haven’t answered them yet.
Is the checklist something we can share?
The blank one is. I’ll check the link.
I wanted her to see that the work had made an impact.
Then we should tell her what was useful.
Someone wants to use the example she made.
That is more specific than increased visibility.
The link works. I’ll send it to her so she can reply.
Does she need another report?
She needs to know what to make next.
I had suggested a post about our approach to meaningful engagement.
She suggested showing how to use the checklist.
Let’s do that.
Are we keeping the ninety-three?
Yes. It is what happened.

ending.heading: Draft · Synergy
lines: One person asked for the checklist.
We sent them the blank version.
Next: show how to use it.
ending.detail: A smaller claim. A useful next step.

performance: Sincere, restrained; preserve original cast voices. New takes require listening review.
